analysis_unit: video-query cluster; traces within a cluster are not treated as independent samples
primary_trace_pair: one deterministic high-vs-low number_of_temporal_regions_touched contrast per eligible stratum; trace-hash tie break
held_out_evaluation: cluster bootstrap by video-query, 10000 resamples, seed 20260812

P1_pass_rule.yield_only_insufficient: LOVO and LOVQO yield-only macro R2 each <= 0.50 OR yield-only has >=0.05 worse MAE than its corresponding policy-visible geometry model
P1_pass_rule.geometry_explanatory_lift: policy-visible geometry improves both LOVO and LOVQO macro MAE by >=0.02 versus yield-only without reference-only predictors
P1_pass_rule.matched_effect: median matched delta human-event coverage > 0 and median matched delta distinct human events touched > 0, with positive direction in >=4/6 video-query clusters
P1_pass_rule.proxy_replication: the matched coverage direction is positive for both Proxy A and Proxy B and is not driven by one video-query cluster
P1_pass_rule.minimum_evidence: >=12 eligible exact-yield strata across >=4 video-query clusters for each proxy family
P1_pass_rule.decision: PASS only when all rules are met; otherwise FAIL/NO_GO.

P1_fail_conditions: only C1 endpoint associates with geometry
matched human effect lacks cross-cluster replication
effect fails for either natural proxy
reference-only variables are required for primary lift
frozen_inputs_required: frozen Proxy A and Proxy B scores
prohibited: human-boundary changes to improve method score
